name: Crealify
oneliner: Remix any short-form video ad you've already shot — drag its scenes into a timeline and swap the persona with one click.
description: Crealify is an open-source video editor for marketers and creators who already shoot short-form ads. Upload one of your existing videos and it gets segmented automatically into reusable blocks (Opener, Problem, Solution, Demo, CTA) using ElevenLabs Scribe for transcription and Claude for boundary detection. Each block becomes a draggable card in your library; you compose new variants on a CapCut-style timeline by mixing and matching them. Then you pick a Persona — an image and an ElevenLabs voice — and Crealify rebuilds every script-bearing clip using speech-to-speech to swap the voice while preserving the original delivery, before stitching everything into a final MP4 you can download. No re-shooting, no re-recording, no manual editing.
